ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Significant high-intensity white mottling at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; left tip shows a broader, more contiguous patch than the right. Scattered high-intensity vertical streaks are present on the medial-right lobe area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 105 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 45 pixels from the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-to-moderate frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-7 pixels along the continuous boundary; most pronounced peaks occur on the distal thirds of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory originating from the median notch, terminating in sharp, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast circular pixel clusters located in the mid-section of the right lobe, suggestive of barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the inner-to-mid section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple vertical rake marks on the right lobe; irregular white scarring/pigmentation at the terminal points of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical white patch on the left distal tip compared to the thinner, more linear white margin on the right tip.
